[Benzinga news, 2026-10-26T13:32:45Z, by staff] Citi Analysts Update Prysmian Outlook Following Atkore Acquisition
Citi analysts have updated their financial projections for Prysmian, citing the positive contribution of the Atkore acquisition to future earnings.
Citi analysts have revised their financial outlook for Prysmian, incorporating the impact of the Atkore acquisition into their models. The firm expects the acquisition to be accretive to Prysmian's adjusted earnings per share (EPS). Citi projects that Atkore's organic growth could reach +10% in 2027 and +9% in 2028, supported by commercial synergies. While noting a higher execution risk associated with these synergies, the bank maintains a positive view on the contribution of Atkore to Prysmian's long-term performance.

[Benzinga news, 2026-10-26T13:01:56Z, by staff] BioNTech and DualityBio Announce Positive Topline Results from Phase 3 DYNASTY-Breast02 Trial
BioNTech SE and DualityBiologics announced that their global Phase 3 clinical trial, DYNASTY-Breast02, evaluating trastuzumab pamirtecan in patients with HR+/HER2-low metastatic breast cancer, has met its primary endpoint.
BioNTech SE and its partner DualityBiologics (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. reported that the global Phase 3 clinical trial DYNASTY-Breast02 (NCT06018337) successfully met its primary endpoint. The study evaluated the efficacy and safety of trastuzumab pamirtecan in patients diagnosed with HR+/HER2-low metastatic breast cancer. This development marks a significant milestone in the companies' collaborative oncology pipeline. Further details regarding the trial data and subsequent regulatory steps are expected to be disclosed as the program progresses.
